expected_level_description: You can: - manage a senior leader's diary, setting priorities with them - decide what needs their time and what others can handle - plan the annual cycle of meetings for a board or leadership team
You can: - manage correspondence for a senior leader, including sensitive and complaint letters - draft replies that need tact, accuracy, and judgement - make sure replies meet deadlines

You can: - take formal minutes of board and committee meetings, including complex or contentious discussion - keep formal meeting records that stand up to audit and inquiry - advise chairs on what the record should show
You can: - build templates, trackers, and simple automated workflows - make documents accessible to everyone - help colleagues get the most from office tools
You can: - support committee meetings, papers, and minutes - keep governance registers up to date
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly

You can: - work collaboratively in a group and build relationships with others - identify issues through Agile 'health checks' and work with others to address them - manage stakeholder expectations - be flexible and capable of proactive and reactive communication - host or moderate difficult discussions within the team or with senior stakeholders

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
